name: profilefill-extension
description: Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that lets you create profiles from your resume and auto-fill job application forms. All data stays in your browser—no backend, no uploads.

scripts.setup-libs: mkdir -p libs && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist-legacy/pdf.min.js node_modules/pdfjs-dist-legacy/pdf.worker.min.js libs/ && cp node_modules/mammoth/mammoth.browser.min.js libs/
